ancillary_update.description: Disconnected general multigraded schemes in five variables exist

authored_proofs.scope: Positive integer coarsening of the abelian grading; h(0)=1; all other support has weight 1 or 2; stated rank bounds
authored_proofs.conclusion: Smooth and geometrically irreducible if nonempty
Geometrically connected; no smoothness or irreducibility claim
authored_proofs.novelty: not claimed; a self-contained control within the classical standard-grading case

remaining_gap: Arbitrary abelian grading and admissible Hilbert function in three variables; positive grading reduces to finite support but not to weight cutoff two or three.
